sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content: By default, Mythical Void stores your creatures, progress, and preferences locally on your device using browser localStorage. If you explicitly enable optional Cloud Save, a versioned copy of your game progress, an anonymous account identifier, and save timestamps are sent to our Supabase database so your progress can be recovered. Cloud Save is disabled by default. Creature media uses only bounded fictional creature traits and an optional pixel-creature reference image. A protected Living Portrait may then become the visual reference for a short Creature Story Scene. We do not send the player-given creature name, player identity, age, location, free text, save history, friend data, voice, photograph or device information to an image or video model. An optional adult feedback pulse stores only fixed-choice answers, the submission time and the current release identifier. It does not ask for a name, email address, free-text answer, exact age or child details.

sections.heading: Local Storage
sections.content:
Your primary game save is stored in your browser's localStorage. This means:
• No account or login is required to play
• Clearing browser data can delete local-only saves
• The game remains playable if Cloud Save is unavailable
• Cloud synchronization occurs only after you explicitly enable it

sections.heading: Optional Adult Email Accounts
sections.content: Where available, adults aged 18 or over can choose an email account to continue their creatures on another device. We ask for an adult declaration, not a date of birth. Google Firebase Authentication processes the email identity and verified sign-in session. Email links are for sign-in and recovery, not marketing. Google Cloud Firestore stores the adult declaration time, notice version and only the adventures you explicitly add, including creature names, progress, protected media references and save timestamps. Google Cloud Run verifies access. Device safety profiles, guardian PINs and local safety history are excluded. Your email is not put in game snapshots, analytics events or creature-media requests. The browser keeps a separate sign-in session until you sign out and temporarily remembers an email address while a sign-in link is pending. In Save across devices you can remove online copies, sign out on this browser or delete the email account. Deletion removes the Firebase identity and online adventure copies; copies already on your devices remain there. A minimal account deletion marker prevents delayed requests from recreating deleted saves. Existing anonymous creature media remains under its original storage controls; account access uses anonymous owner identifiers, without sending your email or Firebase sign-in token to that media provider. Provider backups and service/security logs follow their own retention policies. No account is required to play.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.content:
Mythical Void uses the following external services:
• Google Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore and Cloud Run: Where optional adult accounts are enabled, these services handle email-link sign-in and the adventure copies adults choose to save. Firebase authentication is separate from anonymous creature media. Google maintains normal security and service logs.
• Supabase: Creature media uses an anonymous technical session for abuse controls, private files and opaque job ownership. Cloud Save remains a separate optional feature. Supabase maintains normal security and service logs.
• Replicate and configured Google Gemini/Veo models: These services receive only a fictional creature image, bounded creature traits and developer-authored scene instructions. They do not receive the player-given creature name, player identity, age, location, device information, voice, photograph, free text, save history or friend data.
• NASA APIs: We fetch publicly available astronomical images and data. No game profile is sent to NASA.
• Netlify: Our game and protected application functions are hosted on Netlify, which maintains standard server access logs such as IP addresses and timestamps. The backend calls media providers so the player's network address is not part of the model request.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.content: Mythical Void is designed for players of all ages, including children. No account is required and local play remains available without Cloud Save. Creature Portraits and Creature Story Scenes describe the player's fictional creature; they are not personalized to the child and model requests contain no child or player information. Cloud Save and friend-linking remain separate and unavailable to profiles that identify as under 16 in this release. The selected age range stays on the device and is not sent to an image or video model. We do not intentionally request a child's email address, exact birth date or physical location. The separate feedback pulse is only for adults aged 18 or over. Email accounts are offered only to adults aged 18 or over. A profile marked under 18 is not shown an email sign-up form.

sections.heading: Adult Feedback
sections.content: The optional adult feedback pulse requires an adult confirmation and records eight fixed-choice answers, including broad choices for how the adult found Mythical Void and what made them want to try it, plus the submission time and current release identifier. It does not store a referring address or create an account, and it does not store a name, email address, free-text answer, exact age, user or session identifier, creature name, device detail or location in the feedback record. The fixed-choice record is kept for no more than 180 days and is available only to the protected server role. Standard Netlify and Supabase service and security logs remain subject to their own operational retention.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.content: Local saves remain under your device's control. Optional cloud saves are protected through authenticated access and database policies that restrict each player to their own record. Living Portrait and Creature Story Scene files are copied into private storage; save files contain protected asset references rather than storage paths or expiring access links. Creature-media provider prompts are assembled from an allowlist and exclude player data. Guardian PIN data and local safety audit history are excluded from cloud uploads. You can disable Cloud Save without deleting the existing copy, or delete the remote save, protected creature media, and anonymous technical identity from the in-game settings.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy as the game develops. Material changes to data collection or Cloud Save will be presented before the affected feature is enabled. The 'Last Updated' date identifies the current version.
